description: The stored panel must follow the canonical MODELING_PANEL_COLUMNS schema exactly.
The modeling panel must not contain duplicated column names.
The current master-panel contract expects exactly 91 candidate predictors.
Every non-missing candidate predictor must be numeric.
Candidate predictors may be NaN but must never contain infinity.
Every candidate predictor must have at least one historical observation.
Every rebalance date must contain the same configured security cross-section.
The dataset must contain historical observations with completed targets.
Observations without future targets must appear only after the completed modeling history.
target_21d_excess must equal target_21d minus the same-date cross-sectional median.
The cross-sectional median of target_21d_excess must be zero on every modeling date.
label_top_quintile must be binary for every modeling observation.
Top-quintile observations must not have lower future returns than non-top-quintile observations on the same date.
Every panel column must have exactly one dictionary entry.
The data dictionary must exactly cover the stored modeling-panel schema.
Dictionary model_input=True columns must exactly equal MODEL_FEATURE_COLUMNS.
Every Step 11B leakage and point-in-time check must pass.
